newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss sight deposits rise to 4,249.1 million Sfr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss sight deposits rise to 4,249.1 million Sfr.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank said sight deposits rose by 169.3 million Swiss francs to 4.25 billion in the reporting period ended June 30.
Statement of July 1 in millions of Swiss francs:
Borrowing at the emergency Lombard window rose by 69.9 million francs to 70.0 million in the reporting period.
Outstanding borrowing via the discount facility and swaps of money market certificates fell by 639.8 million francs to 1,897.6 million.
The SNB said it used a dollar exchange rate of 1.4533 for its end-of-quarter conversions, compared with 1.4582 at the end of the first quarter and 1.3500 at the end of 1996.
It said it booked an exchange rate-related loss of 191.7 million in the second quarter, reducing exchange rate-linked book profits since the end of 1996 to 2,263.6 million francs.
